시편-71-1.title: 시편 71장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-71-1.exegesis: PSALM 70 Psa 70:1-5 . This corresponds to Psa 40:13-17 with a very few variations, as "turn back" ( Psa 70:3 ) for "desolate," and "make haste unto me" ( Psa 70:5 ) for "thinketh upon me." It forms a suitable appendix to the preceding, and is called "a Psalm to bring to remembrance," as the thirty-eighth [see on Psa 38:1 , title].
시편-71-1.theologicalNote: PSALM 70 Psa 70:1-5 . This corresponds to Psa 40:13-17 with a very few variations, as "turn back" ( Psa 70:3 ) for "desolate," and "make haste unto me" ( Psa 70:5 ) for "thinketh upon me." 시편-71-2.title: 시편 71장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-71-2.exegesis: PSALM 71 Psa 71:1-24 . The Psalmist, probably in old age, appeals to God for help from his enemies, pleading his past favors, and stating his present need; and, in confidence of a hearing, he promises his grateful thanks and praise. 1-3. (Compare Psa 30:1-3 ).
